subject.title: GChat: Typing indicator persists after NO_REPLY + emoji reaction

question: Should maintainers adopt the open fork PR as the implementation path for this Google Chat NO_REPLY placeholder cleanup, or close it and queue a replacement fix?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open unmerged fork PR already closes this issue and cannot be maintainer-edited, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers choose the landing path.

options.title: Adopt or review fork PR
options.body: Refresh and prove the open fork PR if maintainers want to preserve that contributor path despite failed checks and no maintainer-modify access.

options.title: Close candidate and replace
options.body: Close the fork PR as non-viable, then queue a narrow replacement against current main while preserving contributor credit where appropriate.

options.title: Wait for contributor
options.body: Leave the issue blocked on the fork author if maintainers expect the contributor to provide proof and updates soon.

recommendation.title: Adopt or review fork PR
recommendation.body: Refresh and prove the open fork PR if maintainers want to preserve that contributor path despite failed checks and no maintainer-modify access.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the Google Chat reply-delivery and channel turn surfaces where the cleanup belongs.
